items.description: Akela must immediately give Google written notice that an FS Default Trigger has occurred.
items.span_text: Akela will immediately provide Google written notice (the “Google Default Notice”) that the FS Default Trigger has occurred.
items.trigger: In the event that (i) Fluidstack has become subject to an Insolvency Event or (ii) an Event of Default under Section 15.1.1 of the Fluidstack Lease has occurred

items.description: Akela and Fluidstack must cooperate in a timely way with Google's reasonable requests for information and documents about the FS Default Trigger.
items.span_text: Akela and Fluidstack will timely cooperate with reasonable requests by Google for information and documentation regarding the FS Default Trigger.

items.anchor_event: receipt of the Google Default Notice
items.description: Verification Period during which Google verifies the FS Default Trigger, running from receipt of the Google Default Notice.
items.name: Verification Period
items.span_text: Google will have a period of 30 days after receipt of the Google Default Notice (“Verification Period”) to verify that the requirements of the FS Default Trigger have been met.

items.anchor_event: end of the Verification Period that results in Google having elected the Google Rejection Option
items.description: Akela must send a termination confirmation notice with an invoice for the FS Termination Fee within the stated period after the Verification Period ends.
items.span_text: Akela will send notice to Fluidstack and Google confirming Akela’s termination of the Fluidstack Lease, together with a correct invoice for Google in the amount of the FS Termination Fee (as defined below) (the “Akela Termination Notice”)
items.trigger: If Google elects (or is deemed to have elected) the Google Rejection Option

items.anchor_event: receipt of the Akela Termination Notice
items.description: Google must pay Akela the FS Termination Fee within the stated period after receiving the Akela Termination Notice.
items.span_text: Google will, within 15 days after the receipt of the Akela Termination Notice (including the associated invoice), pay Akela a termination fee (the “FS Termination Fee”).
items.trigger: If Google elects (or is deemed to have elected) the Google Rejection Option

items.description: Google must enter into the Google Financial Support Agreement when Akela requests it in writing in connection with Akela's financing.
items.span_text: Google agrees to enter into the Google Financial Support Agreement upon the written request of Akela in connection with the incurrence of Akela’s financing arrangements.
items.trigger: upon the written request of Akela in connection with the incurrence of Akela’s financing arrangements

items.anchor_event: Google’s provision of the Google Election Notice to Akela
items.description: Google, Akela and Fluidstack must execute the Novation Agreement within the stated period after Google gives its election notice.
items.span_text: (i) Google, Akela, and Fluidstack must (within fifteen (15) days after Google’s provision of the Google Election Notice to Akela) execute a novation agreement
items.trigger: If Google elects the Google Assumption Option (or is deemed to elect the Google Assumption Option) in accordance with this Agreement

items.anchor_event: receipt of a correct, itemized invoice for such Rent from Akela
items.description: Google must pay the Rent then properly due from Fluidstack within the stated period after receiving a correct itemized invoice from Akela.
items.span_text: Google must pay all Rent that is then, currently, properly due and owing by Fluidstack to Akela under the Fluidstack Lease within fifteen (15) days after the receipt of a correct, itemized invoice for such Rent from Akela.
items.trigger: If Google elects the Google Assumption Option (or is deemed to elect the Google Assumption Option) in accordance with this Agreement

items.description: Google is liable for all Rent under the Fluidstack Lease as it becomes due, whether or not the Novation Agreement has been executed.
items.span_text: Google shall be liable for all Rent under the Fluidstack Lease, as it becomes due, regardless of when (or if) the Novation Agreement is executed and delivered
items.trigger: If Google elects the Google Assumption Option (or is deemed to elect the Google Assumption Option) in accordance with this Agreement

items.description: If the Novation Agreement is deemed executed, Google has the right to terminate the lease early as described in Exhibit D.
items.span_text: Google will have the right to terminate the Lease early as described under Section 1.1(c)(i) (Google’s Early Lease Termination Right) of Exhibit D.
items.trigger: If the Novation Agreement is not executed by Google, Akela, and Fluidstack within the above-mentioned 15-day period
